reviews.t: This is a good product, but the price is too high
reviews.x: I have been using this product for years as an effective antiperspirant/deodorant. There is opinion that it may be harmful because it contains aluminum. On the other hand, I have read an article stating that the harm has not been clinically proven. Anyway, I personally did not experience any harm after using it for years. I think my recent purchase of this product was not quite successful because the price was too high...

reviews.t: Good antiperspirant but not the scent I remember or like
reviews.x: I was hesitant to try an aerosol and I wish I had gone with my gut. I haven’t used an aerosol in eons and now I remember why. It got into the air too much and irritated my sinuses.  The scent is not what I remember. I guess I’ll have to continue looking for an antiperspirant deodorant with a nice scent.  Other than that it will keep you dry and fresh feeling and will dry quickly on your skin. But as I said the scent is way way off.
My husband can't purchase these at the store anymore so we find it easier to get it here. He does not use anything else.

These deodorant spray cans all smell offensively foul, as if they were an old, old item.  I love Soft & Dri Soft Scent and have used it for a long time, both in spray form and the gel and know the scent very well.  These smells like old stock.  I purchased the gel form in another scent which I have never used and it is fine.  These spray cans are going in the trash, like throwing away $20 for the fun of it.  Amazon's policy is non-returnable.

reviews.t: The scent is always soft and sweet
reviews.x: I love the deodorant. It has a lovely scent that last a long time. I couldn’t find it for a long time and I don’t particularly like the rub on application. I have not been able to find a better deodorant for myself with all the deodorants out there.  This is a special scent which I love
Found this years ago at the mammogram center I used to go to. I love the scent. I like spray deodorant because it goes where I want it and feels dry immediately. Good value for the price.
I love this product as I have used for years!! I am sure glad that I found it on this site as they no longer carry it in stores.

reviews.t: The best deoderant in the world
reviews.x: This deodorant is the best last very long next day my arm pits still smell good it’s so good I have my family addicted I would never change it for any other this is the best deodorant I’ve ever purchased I my life it’s the best smell no stains on your clothing it really does last days

reviews.t: Best ever - nothing beats this stuff
reviews.x: It smells wonderful, keeps me dry, and it's gentle on my skin.  It never stains, and I need only two squirts a day.  I love this deodorant, and I'm glad I can buy 3 cans at once.
Got this for my mother she said there's nothing like the old school products
Hope the company will continue to make it. I love it!

This is the absolute best deodorant.  I started using at age 15 and haven't looked back. It smells so clean and keeps me dry unlike some other products. It seems to really match my body chemistry so the fragrance doesn't turn weird

Wife has been using this brand for decades. She has trouble finding it in store-glad to find it on-line. She hasn’t popped a lid on these yet. But, unless they have changed the product, she will be happy.

reviews.t: Everyone should smell this deodorant..it's the best smell in the world.
reviews.x: I can't believe this deodorant that I've used since puberty is no longer available in stores.  Please don't stop selling this.
My favorite anti-persperant. Can no longer find it in my area. Very grateful for Amazon

reviews.t: My favorite deodorant since high school.
reviews.x: People always think it smells like perfume. Been using since the 9th grade!

Not the lovely original powder sent.  I'm sorry to say but this is extremely over powering . Smells like someone put way to much perfume on. I can't even Give this away. And at over $8 dollars a can this isn't worth it at all.  Which is really sad the original soft powder scent was so nice. This stinks. It also gave me a bad headache.

The scent is light and flowery but not overwhelming.  I have been using this for thirty years and love it.  You will not sweat. I have found it cheaper at the store but it was convenient getting it shipped and getting a three pack.

I tried so many deoderants in my lifet but was never too happy till I bought this once and I'm still with it for years already... it's a perfect smell not to strong and not to light... keeps me all day fresh and confident

They sell this is stores if you hunt around forever.  When I finally found it - it was $7 a bottle!  This is a great deal and a great product.  I have been using for years- now all 3 of my adult daughters use it also.
I like the 20% aluminum chlorohydrate  rather than the 24% in most products . The subtle difference is dramatic. Due to the supply chain problems the drugstores struggle to keep them.

reviews.t: The price per unit is ridiculous, I won’t buy it anymore
reviews.x: I think the price is ridiculous for a spray , the quantity inside is less as well , so don’t think for a second that people don’t notice these details .
I love Soft & Dri Deodorant, but lately it's been so hard to find in stores; that's why I'm so glad I found it on Amazon and can once again enjoy it!
The scent of this is awful. It smells like old old lady. I could not even stand it. Its not eligible for returns so I'm out of some money.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent, describing it as soft, sweet, clean, and long-lasting.
Many reviewers have used this product for years or decades and consider it their go-to deodorant.
Several reviewers note they can no longer find the product in stores and are glad to buy it online.
Some reviewers complain about the price being too high or about a stale, unpleasant scent.
A few reviewers mention concerns about aluminum content or irritation from the aerosol spray.
